messages:
Noah Kim: Quick flag on KiteData onboarding — embeddings route showing burst p99 spikes (~3.4s) during bulk document uploads and overall token spend ~33% above forecast. Usage skew: many tiny docs (~<50 tokens) plus periodic 10k-token batch embeddings. Proactive idea: 1) route micro-docs to a compact embeddings model (embed-compact-384-int4), 2) enable dedupe/prefix cache for repeat doc uploads, 3) offload nightly bulk jobs to a Dedicated batch node with higher throughput. Thoughts?

Sofia Alvarez: Agree. For renewal narrative we can frame as "latency guard + cost reduction" — pilot that targets micro-doc traffic first. Can we quantify expected monthly savings for their forecast?

Riya Das: I'll assemble a 48-hour simulation using their traffic slice. Need to know model quality delta expectations for micro-docs — I'll run similarity/regression checks on a 200-sample set.

Marco Li: Technical note: client can set header doc_type="micro" we can use it as deterministic selector. Fallback plan: if cosine_similarity on compact model drops >5% vs baseline for any class, fall back to standard-1.2k embedding model. Also recommend a short TTL for cache entries (120s) to avoid staleness on repeated uploads.

Noah Kim: Draft routing policy (for eng-runtime):
```json
{
  "route": "/embeddings",
  "selector": "(doc_tokens <= 60) || header.doc_type == 'micro'",
  "primary_model": "embed-compact-384-int4",
  "fallback": "embed-standard-1k",
  "cache": {"dedupe": true, "ttl_seconds": 120},
  "batch_window_for_bulk": "23:00-04:00 UTC"
}
```

Marco Li: @eng-runtime-bot please schedule a 2% canary for micro-doc traffic for 24h starting 2026-07-05T22:00:00Z. Add monitors: p50/p95/p99, embedding_cosine_drop, and token_delta. Set regression gate: embedding_cosine_drop <= 5% across classes.

eng-runtime-bot: Canary scheduled: job_id=kite-embed-canary-811234-01, start=2026-07-05T22:00:00Z, traffic=2%, duration=24h. Monitoring hooks: p50/p95/p99, embedding_cosine_drop, token_delta. Will post status. :gear:

Sofia Alvarez: I'll draft a one-slide ROI: projected token cost reduction ~25% on micro-doc path, latency p99 improvement best case 60% (from 3.4s -> ~1.3s). Will caveat with quality gate results.

Riya Das: After canary completes I'll run the 200-sample eval and post a concise pass/fail summary and a handful of failure cases for PM enablement.

Noah Kim: Plan for enablement: 30-min walkthrough with KiteData PM + eng next day after results. I'll update renewal tracker (flag: pilot-in-flight) and add notes for renewal risk mitigation.

Marco Li: If canary is green, propose a gradual ramp: 5% -> 15% -> 50% over 72h with rollback triggers on 5xx spike or embedding_cosine_drop > 5% sustained for 30m.

Sofia Alvarez: Sounds good. tagging CS sync next Tuesday to review outcome and decide whether to include compact-path in renewal SOW. :white_check_mark:
